items.name: ProSilence ANC Wireless Headphones — Over-Ear, 30hr Battery

orderRecord.orderNotes: Product listing accurately describes specifications. The '30-hour battery life' is rated under standard listening conditions (50% volume, ANC off). With ANC enabled, battery life is approximately 12-15 hours, which is stated in the detailed specifications section. This distinction is disclosed on the product page.
